Thought: Now I need to create a LAMMPS input script for NVT equilibration. The script should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each direction and perform NVT equilibration at 300K.
Action: write_file
Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/melting/brief/subtasks/copper_nvt_subtask_melting_trial_1/in.nvt", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Copper NVT equilibration

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read initial structure
read_data Cu.data

# Replicate system 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

# Initialize velocities
velocity all create 300.0 4928459 dist gaussian

# Define compute for temperature
compute myTemp all temp

# NVT equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1

# Output settings
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press density

# Run NVT
timestep 1.0
run 10000

# Write final configuration
write_data Cu_equilibrated.data
"}

# Write final configuration

"}
